_comment: 议题投票数据。candidates=未辩候选(供投票)，debated=已辩(链到辩论)。每个候选的 giscus 讨论 term = 'topic:'+id；净票 = 👍 − 👎(其他表情不计)。votes 字段由 routine 每次跑时用 `gh api graphql` 读 GitHub Discussions 的 👍/👎 回写净票(页面据此显示；点开卡片则加载实时 giscus)。另有一个 term='open-questions' 的讨论(页面『提个新议题』)收观众自提议题——routine 把里面好的提案提炼成新 candidates。新候选议题加进 candidates 即可。

candidates.q: 科技大厂的『扁平化』——一个经理带 30–50 人，会成为常态吗？
candidates.q_en: Big-tech 'flattening' — one manager over 30–50 reports: is this the new normal?
candidates.note: 管理跨度被拉到极限，中层被压扁。这是效率革命，还是把管理责任甩给了无人负责的真空？泰勒制、科层制与零工化的再交锋。
candidates.note_en: Spans of control stretched to the limit, the middle layer squeezed flat. An efficiency revolution, or offloading management into an accountability vacuum? Taylorism, bureaucracy and the gig logic clash again.

candidates.q: 一个好的『管理者』，到底是怎样的？
candidates.q_en: What actually makes a good manager?
candidates.note: 是发号施令的权威，还是为团队铺路的园丁？德鲁克、老子的『无为而治』、稻盛和夫各执一端——好领导是天生的还是练出来的。
candidates.note_en: A commanding authority, or a gardener clearing the way for the team? Drucker, Laozi's 'rule by non-action,' and Inamori take different sides — is good leadership born or built?

candidates.q: 是否有“造物主”，如果有的话，TA为什么要造出人类？
candidates.q_en: Is there a 'Creator'? And if so, why would they have made humankind?
candidates.note: 设计论 vs 自然选择、目的论 vs 不可知——休谟、康德、达尔文、尼采、老子、佛陀各执一端的终极之问。
candidates.note_en: Design vs natural selection, teleology vs agnosticism — the ultimate question, with Hume, Kant, Darwin, Nietzsche, Laozi and the Buddha each taking a side.

candidates.q: AI 时代该怎么养孩子？——拼命鸡娃、挤名校到底还值不值得？
人是否应该追求长生，如果人真的能够长生，世界会怎样？
candidates.q_en: Should we pursue immortality — and if humans really could live forever, what would the world become?
candidates.note: 不只是『该不该』，还有『如果真的实现』——人口、权力、意义、代际更替都会被改写。
candidates.note_en: Not just 'should we,' but 'what if we actually did' — population, power, meaning, and generational renewal would all be rewritten.

candidates.q: 金钱能（在多大程度上）买到幸福？
candidates.q_en: Can money buy happiness — and how much?
candidates.note: 买得到吗？又买得到多少？——从伊壁鸠鲁的『必要欲望』到收入-幸福曲线趋平的那个拐点。
candidates.note_en: Can it — and how much? From Epicurus's 'necessary desires' to where the income–happiness curve flattens.

candidates.q: 人是否拥有真正的自由意志？
candidates.q_en: Do humans have genuine free will?
candidates.note: 我们是真的在选，还是基因、大脑与处境替我们选了？——决定论与能动性之争。
candidates.note_en: Do we really choose, or do genes, brain and circumstance choose for us? — determinism versus agency.

candidates.q: 我们对地球（其他物种、后代）负有怎样的义务？
candidates.q_en: What do we owe the Earth — other species, and future generations?
candidates.note: 对其他物种、对尚未出生的后代——我们凭什么索取，又欠下什么？
candidates.note_en: Toward other species and generations not yet born — by what right do we take, and what do we owe?

candidates.q: 什么样的不平等是可以接受的？
candidates.q_en: What kind of inequality is acceptable?
candidates.note: 机会平等就够了吗？多大的差距是公正、多大是不义？——马克思、哈耶克、亚当·斯密各执一词。
candidates.note_en: Is equal opportunity enough? How much gap is just, how much is wrong? — Marx, Hayek and Adam Smith disagree.

candidates.q: 美，是主观感受，还是有客观的标准？
candidates.q_en: Is beauty just in the eye of the beholder, or is there an objective standard?
candidates.note: 从柏拉图的理念、苏轼的意境，到康德的『无目的的合目的性』与当代神经美学——美到底是什么。
candidates.note_en: From Plato's Forms and Su Shi's poetic mood to Kant's 'purposiveness without purpose' and today's neuroaesthetics — what is beauty, really?

candidates.q: 我们该如何面对死亡？如何做到「向死而生」？
candidates.q_en: How should we face death — and how do we actually live 'toward' it (being-toward-death)?
candidates.note: 伊壁鸠鲁说『死亡与我们无关』，庄子鼓盆而歌，海德格尔说向死而生，佛陀谈无常——直面终点。
candidates.note_en: Epicurus says 'death is nothing to us,' Zhuangzi drummed and sang, Heidegger speaks of being-toward-death, the Buddha on impermanence — facing the end.

candidates.q: 维系和谐，有时是否比说出真相更重要？
candidates.q_en: Is keeping the peace sometimes more important than telling the truth?
candidates.note: 苏格拉底为真理赴死，孔子讲『和』，阿伦特谈真相与政治——在家庭、职场、社会里，何时该说、何时该忍。
candidates.note_en: Socrates died for the truth, Confucius prized harmony, Arendt on truth and politics — in family, work, and society, when to speak and when to hold back.

candidates.q: 数学是被发现的，还是被发明的？
candidates.note: 柏拉图说数学在理念世界里现成等着被发现，也有人说它只是人类心智的发明——一个关于实在本质的老问题。
candidates.note_en: Plato says math waits to be discovered in a realm of Forms; others say it's merely an invention of the human mind — an old question about the nature of reality.

candidates.q: 真爱是发现的，还是培养（甚至建构）出来的？
candidates.q_en: Is true love found, or cultivated — even constructed?
candidates.note: 柏拉图的会饮、叔本华眼里繁衍的诡计、波伏娃对浪漫爱的批判、阿德勒『被爱不如会爱』——爱到底是什么。
candidates.note_en: Plato's Symposium, Schopenhauer's trick of the species, Beauvoir's critique of romantic love, Adler's 'better to love than to be loved' — what love really is.

debated.q: 幸福到底是什么？我们是否应该追求幸福？
debated.q_en: What is happiness, really? And should we even pursue it?

debated.q: AI 时代，人如何夺回注意力与存在的意义？
debated.q_en: In the age of AI, how do we reclaim our attention and the meaning of our existence?

debated.q: AI 取代工作后，人类是否迎来存在危机？普通人怎样面对中年失业？
debated.q_en: After AI replaces human work, will humanity face an existential crisis? How should ordinary people cope with mass midlife unemployment?

debated.q: 原生家庭的创伤：我们多大程度被童年塑造？能否走出？能否改变父母？
debated.q_en: Trauma from the family we're born into: how much does childhood shape us, can we move past it, and can we change our parents?

debated.q: AI 与算法：在增强我们，还是在让我们退化？
debated.q_en: AI and algorithms: are they augmenting us, or making us atrophy?

debated.q: AI 时代该怎么养孩子？——拼命鸡娃、挤名校到底还值不值得？
debated.q_en: Raising kids in the age of AI: is intense “tiger parenting” and chasing elite schools still worth it?
